A [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Hair/Legends|furry]] '''anthropoids''' was native to [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]],<ref name="Ruin" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]].<ref name="Geo">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'' to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] led a team of his fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to Garqi to [[Battle of Garqi|investigate]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], several of these anthropoids were frightened by his [[Best Chance (shuttle)|starship]] as it traversed a [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[Tree/Legends|forest]]. The creatures scurried away from its approach.<ref name="Ruin" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Garqian anthropoids appeared in the [[2000]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'', which was written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]].<ref name="Ruin" />
